target_customer: Recruiting teams, staffing agencies and companies sourcing candidates outbound
problem: Finding qualified candidates by keyword search on profile databases is slow; recruiters need natural language search and automated outreach.

founders.name: Ishan Gupta
education: Dartmouth College, computer science (left to build Juicebox)

technical_complexity.rationale: In 2022 the original talent marketplace was standard engineering; the later LLM search product needed data aggregation across many sources and was feasible once LLM APIs matured.

defensibility.rationale: Aggregated profile data and workflow integrations help, but search over public profiles and LLM wrappers were widely copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found through 2026; the company raised $116M total by March 2026.

market_need_then: Original idea was a talent marketplace (shut October 2022); founders said message market fit came before product market fit. LLM search demand followed in late 2023.

branding.domain_note: juicebox.ai domain used by company (no purchase detail found)

identity.logo: New brand and website announced on company blog

rebrands.why: Company says PeopleGPT is the former name of the search product; platform is Juicebox. Exact date not found.

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt listing for PeopleGPT; Forbes and LinkedIn startup list mentions on company site (2026).

brand_strength.rationale: PeopleGPT product name carried early awareness and the company later consolidated under Juicebox; evidence of brand pull is indirect.

pivots.why: Marketplace was not working as a recurring use case; per founder interview summaries (dealroom, yespress)

outcome_analysis: Juicebox shut its first idea in October 2022, then rebuilt around LLM search for recruiting, launched PeopleGPT in late 2023, and raised a $6M seed, a $30M Series A led by Sequoia in September 2025 and an $80M Series B at $850M in March 2026. Growth claims of 5,000 plus customers are company reported. Success reflects a pivot timed with the LLM wave and fast execution.
notes: Seed date not stated (disclosed alongside Series A as previously unannounced). Series A total of $36M includes seed. ARR and customer counts are company reported. Competitors: no dated source from 2022 found; vendors like hireEZ, SeekOut and Gem were not confirmed by any opened source, so none recorded.
